description: This file defines a React functional component 'FeaturesUsageCharts' that renders two bar charts for visualizing the most and least used features. It imports React, charting components from 'recharts', and custom UI components like Card and Skeleton. The component uses theme context for styling and normalizes input data before rendering charts with conditional loading and empty states.
